messages:
maria: Quick design check — I pushed the in-context doc flyout mock to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Question: should the flyout open on hover (fast discoverability) or require click (a11y + accidental triggers)?
jon: +1 to click for a11y. Hover is fragile esp. on touch. Also click lets us provide a clear focusable element for keyboard users.
kaya: Agreed on click. Also we need a visible focus ring and an aria-expanded state. For screen readers the flyout should announce its role and a short heading, e.g., "Console docs — routing".
maria: Good. One more: when the flyout links into docs, should we deep-link to a specific heading? Example: `/docs/console#batching` vs `/docs/console?panel=flyout&ref=console`.
jon: I'd prefer fragment anchors (`#batching`) for direct headings — easier for copy/paste and stable across redirects. But we should preserve a `ref` param for analytics: `/docs/console#batching?ref=console-flyout` — wait order matters, should be `/docs/console?ref=console-flyout#batching`.
kaya: Small nit: ensure the link opens in a new tab and has `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. For screen readers also provide `aria-label="Open docs about batching (opens in new tab)"`.
docs-bot: Automated note: docs anchor generation PR is in review — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/342 (adding stable ids for headings).
maria: Thinking about copy: current CTA is "Learn more" in the flyout. Feels vague from QA. Options: "Open docs", "Read docs", or microcopy like "See batching guide". Thoughts?
jon: Prefer explicit: "Open docs" is clear but bland. "See batching guide" is more context-rich but requires us to keep CTA in sync with the linked heading.
kaya: I'd vote for contextual CTA where we can ("See batching guide") and fallback to "Open docs" when context is generic. Also add a small helper line: "Press ? to open shortcuts" — jk 😂 but seriously keyboard hint.
maria: For cross-links inside the console (e.g., model route pages) we should include a small inline icon that shows it's an external docs link. CC @jon for iconography.
jon: I'll add a 12px external-link icon and create a token in the design system. Also will update the docs link component to emit telemetry: `docs.link.click` with properties {source: 'flyout', target: '/docs/console', anchor: 'batching'}.
kaya: Telemetry names look fine — just make sure we aren't sending PII. Use path, not full URL.
maria: final question — should the flyout persist state across routes (if open on route A and user navigates to route B)? My leaning: probably not — it's context-specific. Any objections?
jon: No objections. Close on navigation keeps behavior predictable. Could restore last-opened on refresh though.
maria: Great—I'll update the Figma and the ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
jon: Thanks — will add a11y checklist to the PR.
kaya: I'll add the aria copy and test with NVDA on the PR.
summary: Design discussion about in-context doc flyout behavior (click vs hover), accessibility requirements (aria, focus ring, screen reader text), deep-linking and anchor strategy, CTA copy options, telemetry naming, and persistence behavior across routes. Mentions docs PR and action items for design+engineering+docs review.
